excerpt.zh: 强大的灵能流在虚境无边的涡流中碰撞炙烤着。一声刺耳咆哮不断膨胀，引起我们的注意。
excerpt.en: Powerful psionic currents crash and broil amid the Shroud's unending turbulence. A roaring cacophony swells and clamors for our attention.

texts.zh: 强大的灵能流在虚境无边的涡流中碰撞炙烤着。一声刺耳咆哮不断膨胀，引起我们的注意。
texts.en: Powerful psionic currents crash and broil amid the Shroud's unending turbulence. A roaring cacophony swells and clamors for our attention.

texts.zh: 痛苦的呼喊，雷鸣般的战争之乐，隆隆的吞噬之火。我们能感觉到疼痛……但这是谁的？
texts.en: Cries of pain, the thunderous orchestra of battle, a rumble of devouring flames. We sense pain... To whom does it belong?

texts.zh: 哭嚎喊叫，兽性的，野性的，原始的……河流奔涌，狂风呼啸……整个大自然都在同时狂吠嚎叫着，无比急切……
texts.en: Cries and calls, animalistic, wild, primal... Rivers gush and winds wail... All of nature barks and howls, urgently and at once...

texts.zh: 各种心声低语着、呢喃着、惊呼着、宣告着……无数的语调、音节、声音……多重的语言同时在交流。
texts.en: Voices murmur, mumble, exclaim and declare... Myriad intonations, syllables, sounds... Multitudinous languages chatter at once.

texts.zh: 钻头钻孔，机械研磨……物质在巨大的噪声中被强制转化……宇宙中所有的工厂同时迸发出火焰。
texts.en: Drills bore, machinery grinds... Matter is loudly and forcefully transformed... All the factories of the universe blast and fire at the same time.

texts.zh: 噪音难以忍受。
texts.en: The noise is overwhelming.

tooltips.zh: 这个选择将会与虚境发生共鸣……
tooltips.en: This choice will resonate within the Shroud...

tooltips.zh: 中概率获得一项虚境的恩赐
tooltips.en: Medium Chance to get a Boon of the Shroud

texts.zh:
这份渐强逐渐积累。我们突然被推到一个无法理解的方向……

最后，我们又恢复了沉默。
texts.en:
The crescendo builds and builds. We are suddenly thrust in a direction we cannot comprehend...

Finally we settle back into silence.

summary.text:
# 分裂刺耳 / Fractious Cacophonies

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:5672-5856`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5819-5854 (on_patron_delve_failed: 28 events × 100, utopia.3002 × 1)`; `common/scripted_variables/09_scripted_variables_shroud.txt:8,109-114 (attunement ±50/100/200; 30-year retrigger 10800 days)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

潜入虚境但没有找到其他事件（on_patron_delve_failed）时，从28个权重各为100的遭遇（另有权重1的 utopia.3002 兜底）中随机抽取一个满足条件的；每次潜入失败只出现一个遭遇，不会依次经历全部。本遭遇随当前所在的主要赞助者领域（喰煞/织缕/月窠/器具）改变文本；不能与该赞助者已立约；对每位赞助者各可发生一次，且触发后30年内不会再次出现。

When a Shroud delve finds nothing else (on_patron_delve_failed), one eligible encounter is drawn at random from 28 candidates of weight 100 each (plus utopia.3002 at weight 1 as fallback); each failed delve shows one encounter, never all of them in sequence. The text follows the current major-patron domain (Eater/Composer/Cradle/Instrument); not with a covenant with that patron; it can occur once per patron and not again within 30 years.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

刺耳的喧嚣要求我们的注意，内容随所在领域而变（痛苦、野性、众声、工厂）。

A roaring cacophony demands attention; its content follows the domain (pain, wilderness, voices, factories).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

“陪伴其畔”→3051（中概率恩赐）：所在领域赞助者契合度+100；“转身拒绝”→3052：一级泽珞，下次潜入冷却减半。

"Stay with it" → 3051 (medium boon chance): +100 attunement to the domain patron; "turn away" → 3052: tier-1 zro, next delve cooldown halved.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

对照原文核实了触发、选项与回复事件；草稿结构正确（选项→各自的回复窗口，互斥）。本遭遇与同池其他遭遇相互独立，不应串成一条故事。

Trigger, options and reply events were checked against the source; the draft structure is right (each option → its own reply window, mutually exclusive). This encounter is independent of the others in the pool and must not be chained with them.
